description: This file defines a 'NoteEditor' component for a LightningJS application, facilitating note editing with UI elements, input handling, and state management.

classes.name: NoteEditor
classes.description: A LightningJS component allowing users to edit notes with title and content, managing editing state and user input.

methods.name: titleLabel
methods.description: Returns the label for the title field, indicating editing state.

methods.name: contentPreview
methods.description: Provides a truncated preview of the note's content.

methods.name: actionHint
methods.description: Generates contextual user action hints based on editing state.

methods.name: startEditing
methods.description: Enables editing mode and sets cursor to 'title'.

methods.name: getDraft
methods.description: Returns the current draft title and content.
